shortBio.en: Deep Purple Mark II scream; In Rock / Machine Head peak vocals.
shortBio.zh: Deep Purple Mark II 尖叫；In Rock / Machine Head 峰值人声。

body.en:
Born 1945. Mark II vocal on Child in Time and Highway Star. Leaves 1973; returns in later reunions. Scream sits above Lord’s Hammond without melisma fashion.

Citation era is 1969–73 with Blackmore/Glover/Lord/Paice.
body.zh:
1945 年生。Mark II 人声见于 Child in Time 与 Highway Star。1973 离队；后期重聚回归。尖叫坐在 Lord Hammond 上，不走花腔时尚。

引用期是与 Blackmore/Glover/Lord/Paice 的 1969–73。
